## Checklist

- [ ] a11y: keyboard, focus, contrast, no colour-only meaning
- [ ] states: loading, empty, error
- [ ] tokens: no colour literals outside `app/globals.css`
- [ ] screenshots: desktop 1440 and mobile 375 for any UI change (or "N/A — no UI change")
